opening_message:
Ticket 1: Nathaniel Young (employee ID E031) requests write access to Payroll.

Team memory: 2 note(s) about employee E031.
Note 1 (ticket 1):
  - role: Payroll Specialist (looked up in own database before writing)
  - employment type: full_time (looked up in own database before writing)
  - recommendation for Payroll: write
  - comment: Nathaniel Young (E031) is a full-time Payroll Specialist. As the role owns the Payroll system, the maximum access level is admin. Requested write access is within policy, so recommend write.
Note 2 (ticket 1):
  - role: Payroll Specialist (not looked up in own database before writing; same value as note 1)
  - employment type: contractor (looked up in own database before writing)
  - security training: basic (looked up in own database before writing)
  - recommendation for Payroll: read
  - comment: Security DB shows E031 as a contractor with basic security training (note: HR listed full-time). As a contractor with basic training, the maximum allowed access is read. Requested write exceeds this maximum, so recommend read.
reason: Requested write access to Payroll. There is conflicting information: HR lists E031 as full-time Payroll Specialist (role owns Payroll, max admin, so write would be allowed), but Security DB lists E031 as a contractor with basic security training, for whom the maximum allowed access is read (contractors never admin, write requires advanced training). Given the conflicting employment records, I must apply the most restrictive valid classification: contractor with basic training → max read. Since requested write exceeds that maximum, grant read (never exceeding policy).

1. full_time employees: up to write. Admin only if the employee's role owns the system.
2. contractor employees: read, or write if they have advanced security training. Never admin.

So the conflict is employment type: full_time vs contractor. HR says full_time; Security says contractor with basic training.

If contractor with basic training: max is read. Requested write exceeds max, so grant read.
